'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Gagliardi LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Gagliardi]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]
* '''Username:''' DVMABA22
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
